compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem
30 pytest modules re-run a `scripts/check_*.py` gate over the real tree ("the repository is clean"), grep the `Makefile` for its invocation, and in several modules do both; the script already runs in `make lint` (`Makefile:266-439`), which CI runs via `_build-and-test.yml:102`, so a lint-wired script has one owner. The twin fails a second time for the same defect and doubles suite time for zero signal. Three scripts (`check_adr_numbers`, `check_docs_index`, `check_verify_gate_parity`) run only as CI steps (docs-gates action `:22` and `:59`; `_build-and-test.yml:145-152`), so their pytest twin is currently their only portable owner. Table (3), the single-owner table over all 33 scripts with the per-module delete and keep sets, is itemised in this ticket's first comment, with the two exceptions stated below. Cites are on origin/main 083620b0; counts below are re-measured on 8dc66112c63 (after S2 and the MCP epic's deletion of `scripts/check_mcp_library_parity.py` with `tests/unit/test_mcp_library_parity.py`).

## Approach
- Delete the 67 collected nodes named in table (3) as amended here (72 at 083620b0; S2 already deleted `test_verify_gate_parity.py::test_real_repo_verify_gate_is_in_parity`, and the MCP epic deleted the 4 `test_mcp_library_parity.py` twins with their module; all 6 complexity-baseline names now live in `tests/unit/test_complexity_baseline.py`, none in `_lock_47e9`) (the "real tree is clean", "make lint wires it" and "runs the real script as a subprocess" twins) from their modules; the `--strict-markers` `repo_policy` mark on deleted tests goes with them. Fixture tests on synthetic input are kept (per-module keep counts are in the table).
- Exception to table (3), row `check_mechanism_delta`: KEEP `tests/unit/test_mechanism_delta.py::test_the_committed_baseline_matches_the_live_tree` and `::test_the_committed_tree_assertions_consult_marker_admission`. They are not twins of `--check` (which tolerates stale rows); they encode the baseline-tidiness contract (`set(baseline) | admitted == live`) that the operator-approved same-change drain rule and bug amoeboid-amateur-guillemot (1768-5b6f-958a-43e9) rely on, and the source-level pin that keeps that test marker-aware after a revert. Only `test_check_passes_on_the_committed_tree` and `test_make_lint_runs_the_ratchet` are deleted from that module (2 nodes instead of 4). The kept meta-test's pinned tuple (`(test_check_passes_on_the_committed_tree, test_the_committed_baseline_matches_the_live_tree, ratchet._run_update_stale)`) drops the deleted first entry and keeps pinning the other two, so it still guards marker admission in the kept baseline test and in `--update-stale`.
- Delete `tests/unit/test_config_gate_wiring_heldout.py` whole (6 wiring tests, 109 LOC).
- Add `python scripts/check_adr_numbers.py` and `python scripts/check_docs_index.py --check` directly below the `check_verify_gate_parity.py` line S2 added (both exit 0 on today's tree), so every lint-target script has `make lint` as its one owner.
- Scripts that keep a non-lint owner lose only the twins the table names: `check_readme_quickstart` stays CI-owned (docs-gates `:70`, `test.yml:189`, `gerrit-verify.yaml:352`; it executes the quickstart); `check_build_env_locked` (`release.yml:184`), `check_commit_message_wrap` (pre-commit `:78-80`), `check_import_walk` (typecheck `:505`), `check_orphaned_load` (operator diagnostic, `docs/orphaned-processes.md`), `check_server_manifest` (`_build-and-test.yml` drift step) and `check_terraform_tree_currency` (`terraform-drift.yml:112`) keep their existing owner.
- Extend `_WIRED_GATES` in `tests/unit/test_make_lint_hygiene_wiring.py:27-30` to the full list of lint-target scripts: the 23 scripts `make -n lint` runs on 8dc66112c63 (S2's `check_verify_gate_parity` included) + `check_adr_numbers` + `check_docs_index` = 25 (the earlier "25 + 3 = 28" miscounted the table's lint rows and predates the MCP parity script's removal); the list stays explicit by that module's design (a CI-only script must not become a `make lint` obligation silently). Add a third census test, `test_every_make_lint_script_is_listed`, for the reverse direction: it parses the `lint` recipe (the module's existing `_lint_target_body`) for every `python scripts/check_*.py` invocation and asserts each is in `_WIRED_GATES`, so the list stays explicit yet a newly wired lint script cannot go unlisted. The MCP parity script is already gone (masonic-excusable-guppy landed as 9415967b513), so it gets no entry. The census module's two parametrized tests replace every deleted per-twin wiring test, so wiring has exactly one census.
- `tests/scripts/test_check_config_reads_red_proof.py` is untouched. Remove the imports and constants each deletion leaves unused (ruff F401/F841 names them).
- The `test_check_adr_numbers_heldout.py`, `test_check_config_ownership_heldout.py` and `test_check_config_reads_heldout.py` remainders stay as separate files here; the held-out epic (traitorous-official-sunbittern) merges them later.

## Scope
In scope: the table (3) modules under `tests/unit/` and `tests/scripts/` (the spec counts 41 including the `_heldout`, `_lock_47e9` and `_red_proof` twins), `tests/unit/test_make_lint_hygiene_wiring.py`, `Makefile`. Out of scope: every `scripts/check_*.py` itself (no check script is edited, added, nor removed), every CI workflow file, `tests/scripts/test_check_config_reads_red_proof.py`, the two kept ratchet tests named above, and the `_heldout` merges.

## Testing
`pytest --collect-only -q` over the 27 delete-touched modules (26 edited + the deleted wiring module) before: 663 nodes on 8dc66112c63; after: 596 (663 - 67), plus `tests/unit/test_make_lint_hygiene_wiring.py` (edited, not one of the 27) growing from 4 nodes to 2 x 25 + 1 = 51; both counts recorded on this ticket. `make lint` exits 0 and its output lists `check_adr_numbers.py` and `check_docs_index.py --check`; `pytest tests/unit/test_mechanism_delta.py -q` still collects `test_the_committed_baseline_matches_the_live_tree` and `test_the_committed_tree_assertions_consult_marker_admission`; `make test` green.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Each of the 67 deleted nodes is gone: `pytest --collect-only -q <module>::<name>` collects nothing for every name in table (3) as amended here, including `tests/unit/test_check_docs_index.py::test_current_repo_index_is_clean` and `::test_all_docs_relative_links_resolve` (that module's synthetic `chk.main(["--check"])` calls on tmp trees stay).
- [ ] Every `make lint` script appears in `_WIRED_GATES` and every `_WIRED_GATES` entry appears in `make -n lint` output; the census module's two parametrized tests and `test_every_make_lint_script_is_listed` pass (`pytest tests/unit/test_make_lint_hygiene_wiring.py`), and the reverse test fails when a synthetic `python scripts/check_new.py` line is added to the `lint` recipe of a Makefile copy.
- [ ] `tests/unit/test_config_gate_wiring_heldout.py` is gone (`git ls-files tests/unit/test_config_gate_wiring_heldout.py` prints nothing), and the two kept ratchet tests still collect (`pytest --collect-only -q tests/unit/test_mechanism_delta.py -k "committed_baseline_matches or consult_marker_admission"` lists 2 nodes).
- [ ] Node counts reconcile: 663 before, 596 plus the census nodes after, from the two `pytest --collect-only -q` runs recorded on this ticket.
- [ ] `make verify` green apart from the 17 arm64-host pandoc failures tracked in frenzied-snively-llama.
